text_blocks.snippet: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) provides guidance on preventing and managing COVID-19. Key recommendations include vaccination, testing, and implementing measures to reduce transmission like masking and physical distancing. Treatment options, including antiviral medications, are also available for those who are eligible and experience severe illness, especially those with risk factors.
